development_scope: two-view perspective camera recovery from matched RGB features, independent of body priors and cosplay
new_features: explicit foreground-mask SIFT matching and source SHA-256 provenance
two-view essential matrix RANSAC with epipolar nonlinear refinement
positive-depth triangulation and cross-view reprojection validation
strict arbitrary-unit baseline and nonmetric coordinate evidence
unchanged_project_limitations: No validation of metric human-body measurements from ordinary images
No learned anthropometric scale without manual dimensions
Camera intrinsics and matching features must still be supplied or estimated outside this module
Two-view relative reconstruction has an unobservable absolute similarity scale
Foreground SIFT matching may fail on smooth or deforming human surfaces
Automatic body-model fitting is not integrated with the new relative cameras
next_scientific_objective: Unseen paired real RGB/body-scan validation, including camera/scale estimation and uncertainty calibration
